summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature (open and wrap_file) in rich/progress.py, with tests in tests/test_progress.py, docs in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry. Changes are additive and uncommitted. I did not run tests, mypy, or any repository code, so everything is verified by reading only; run pytest tests/test_progress.py and mypy rich to confirm. The strict-mode mypy suppressions follow the spec's list, and they may be flagged as unused if they don't match what mypy reports.
